Citation.yaml:
Citation:
    description: >-
      Where in one source a statement's evidence lies: the source, and the record, page, scan,
      time, piece of the paper, address or pointer within it, with the quoted words.
    attributes:
      source_id:
        # docs/design/2026-10-24-sources-and-citations.md, section 3.3, and
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding fact_source: the record a statement rests on is
        # its evidence.
        slot_uri: rico:isEvidencedBy
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        annotations:
          references: Source.id
        description: >-
          The record the statement rests on (the original where it is known), by its id in the
          record's sources.
      via:
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The one source actually read, a copy or a transcription of the original, by its id.
      reference_code:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding source_reference_code.
        slot_uri: rico:hasOrHadIdentifier
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The holder's reference of the document cited, where the source is a set of many.
      record_type:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding citation_record_type.
        slot_uri: rico:hasDocumentaryFormType
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The holder's own type of the record, such as Page of Testimony.
      quote_language:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding source_language.
        slot_uri: rico:hasOrHadLanguage
        range: LanguageTag
        description: >-
          The quote's language, where it is not the source's (a translation).
      public_note:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding citation_public_note.
        slot_uri: pc:site_citation_public_note
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          Our reviewed words for the page about this evidence, apart from the record's quote.
      locator:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding citation_locator.
        slot_uri: pc:site_citation_locator
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          An internal pointer into the project's files; never published and never a holder's
          record number.
      record_id:
        # docs/design/2026-10-24-sources-and-citations.md, section 3.3: the holder's own number
        # for the record maps to rico:hasOrHadIdentifier.
        slot_uri: rico:hasOrHadIdentifier
        range: string
        description: >-
          The holder's own number for the record, such as a Yad Vashem record number.
      page:
        range: string
        description: >-
          The page, folio or entry cited.
      scan:
        range: string
        description: >-
          The scan or image cited.
      time:
        range: string
        description: >-
          The time in a recording.
      edition_date:
        range: string
        description: >-
          The day of the paper's issue cited, written YYYY-MM-DD.
      unit_id:
        range: string
        description: >-
          The piece of the paper cited, by its content item id.
      url:
        range: HttpsUri
        description: >-
          The record's web address.
      quote:
        range: string
        description: >-
          The record's own words, exactly.
      note:
        range: string
        description: >-
          Our private note on the evidence; never published.
      accessed:
        range: IsoDay
        description: >-
          The day a person read the record.
    any_of:
      - description: >-
          A citation names where in its source the evidence is.
        slot_conditions:
          record_id:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          page:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          scan:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          time:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          unit_id:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          url:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          locator:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          reference_code:
            required: true

ContentItem.yaml:
ContentItem:
    description: >-
      One article, notice, greeting or advertisement of the issue: its kind, its titles, its
      text and English, the regions it is printed in and what it names.
    class_uri: ehri:RecordResource
    annotations:
      impresso: >-
        A content item file (paper_contentitem.schema.json).
    attributes:
      id:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The content item's id within the issue.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            The content item's id.
      type:
        range: ImpressoTypes
        required: true
        description: >-
          The content item's kind, one of Impresso's content item types.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            The content item's type (tp).
      subtype:
        range: ContentItemSubtypes
        slot_uri: rico:hasDocumentaryFormType
        description: >-
          The narrower form the content item takes within its kind, such as a wedding
          greeting within advertisements, where one is known.
      printed_title:
        range: PrintedTitle
        inlined: true
        slot_uri: rico:hasOrHadTitle
        description: >-
          The title as printed above the content item, where it has one.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            The content item's title.
      supplied_title:
        range: SuppliedTitle
        inlined: true
        required: true
        slot_uri: rico:hasOrHadTitle
        description: >-
          A title in English supplied for the content item.
      subject_ids:
        range: Subjects
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        slot_uri: rico:hasOrHadSubject
        description: >-
          What the content item is about, as subjects of the site-content vocabulary.
      section_id:
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The printed section the content item stands under, by the section's id, where it
          stands under one.
      full_text:
        required: true
        related_mappings:
          - pc:site_site_copy
        description: >-
          The content item's printed text, a copy made for the site from the lines of its
          regions.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            The content item's rebuilt full text (ft).
      translation:
        range: Translation
        inlined: true
        description: >-
          The content item's text in English, where it has been translated.
      reading_status:
        range: ReadingStatus
        inlined: true
        exact_mappings:
          - pc:site_reading_status
        description: >-
          How far the text and the English have been checked; left out or null where it is
          not recorded.
      block_breaks:
        range: NonNegativeInteger
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        related_mappings:
          - pc:site_site_copy
        description: >-
          Where each region's text begins in the full text, counted in Unicode code points.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            The text offsets of page regions (rb).
      page_blocks:
        range: ContentItemBlockRef
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        minimum_cardinality: 1
        related_mappings:
          - pc:site_site_copy
        description: >-
          The regions the content item is printed in, page by page, in reading order.
      location_ids:
        range: NonBlankText
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          The places the content item names, by their ids in the shared record.
      organization_ids:
        range: NonBlankText
        multivalued: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          The organisations the content item names, by their ids in the shared record.
      cross_references:
        range: CrossReference
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          Links from this content item to others in the issue.
      event_id:
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The life event the content item prints, by the event's id, where it prints one.
    rules:
      - description: >-
          A greeting, thanks, notice, announcement, appeal or commercial advertisement is an
          advertisement (ad).
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            subtype:
              equals_string_in:
                - wedding_greeting
                - engagement_greeting
                - birth_greeting
                - bar_mitzvah_greeting
                - new_year_greeting
                - departure_greeting
                - greeting
                - thanks
                - meeting_notice
                - announcement
                - appeal
                - commercial_advertisement
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: ad
      - description: >-
          A condolence, memorial notice or death announcement is a death notice (death_notice).
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            subtype:
              equals_string_in:
                - condolence
                - memorial_notice
                - death_announcement
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: death_notice
      - description: >-
          An editorial, opinion, letter, poem or sketch is an article.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            subtype:
              equals_string_in:
                - editorial
                - opinion
                - letter
                - poem
                - sketch
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: article
      - description: >-
          A humorous piece (humour) is entertainment.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            subtype:
              equals_string_in:
                - humour
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: entertainment

      related_person_id:
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          For kinship: the relative, by the person's id in the record.
      relationship_type:
        range: RelationshipTypes
        description: >-
          For kinship: how the relative is related, from the subject to the relative.
      related_name:
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          For kinship: the relative's name, where the relative has no person of their own.
      qualifiers:
        range: FactQualifiers
        inlined: true
        description: >-
          More about the statement, as named texts.
      holocaust_related:
        range: boolean
        description: >-
          True when the statement concerns the Holocaust.
      citations:
        range: Citation
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        minimum_cardinality: 1
        description: >-
          The evidence: where in which sources the statement is found.
      evidence_confidence:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding fact_certainty.
        slot_uri: rico:relationCertainty
        range: Confidence
        required: true
        description: >-
          How sure the evidence makes the statement.
      identity_confidence:
        range: Confidence
        required: true
        description: >-
          How sure it is that the statement is about this person.
      status:
        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding standing (claim status and review together).
        related_mappings:
          - pc:site_standing
        range: ClaimStatus
        required: true
        description: >-
          The statement's standing: proposed, accepted, disputed or rejected.

        # vocabulary/site-content.json, binding standing.

          - pc:site_standing
        range: Review
        inlined: true
        required: true
        description: >-

        range: Attribution
        inlined: true
        required: true

      - description: >-
          A fact of type other has a proposed type, and only such a fact has one.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: other
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            proposed_type:
              required: true
        elseconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            proposed_type:
              value_presence: ABSENT
      - description: >-
          A kinship fact names the relationship and the relative.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: kinship
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            relationship_type:
              required: true

            - slot_conditions:
                related_name:
                  required: true
            - slot_conditions:

                  required: true
      - description: >-

        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: occupation
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            value:
              required: true
      - description: >-
          A residence fact has a place or a value.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            type:
              equals_string: residence
        postconditions:
          any_of:
            - slot_conditions:
                place_id:
                  required: true
            - slot_conditions:
                value:
                  required: true
      - description: >-

        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:

        postconditions:

Name.yaml:
Name:
    description: >-
      One name of a person, a family, an organisation or a place, of one kind (printed, birth,
      married, supplied and so on), in one script. A person's, a family's and an
      organisation's names are agent names and a place's are place names (vocabulary/
      site-content.json, bindings agent_name and place_name), so the class itself names no
      single term.
    attributes:
      value:
        range: NonBlankText
        required: true
        description: >-
          The name, as written.
      kind:
        range: NameKinds
        required: true
        description: >-
          What kind of name it is: printed, birth, married, supplied and so on.
      script:
        range: ScriptCode
        required: true
        description: >-
          The script it is written in, as a four-letter ISO 15924 code such as Hebr or Latn.
      lang:
        range: SimpleLanguageTag
        description: >-
          Its language, as a language tag such as yi or en.
      citations:
        range: Citation
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        description: >-
          Where the name is found.
      attribution:
        range: Attribution
        inlined: true
        description: >-
          For a supplied name only: who wrote the description, and on what day.
    rules:
      - description: >-
          A supplied name has its attribution and its citations.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            kind:
              equals_string: supplied
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            attribution:
              required: true
            citations:
              required: true
      - description: >-
          Only a supplied name has an attribution.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            attribution:
              value_presence: PRESENT
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            kind:
              equals_string: supplied

        range: string

        range: MediaKind
        required: true
        description: >-
          What the medium is: image, audio, video or document.
      caption:
        # vocabulary/media.json, binding media_caption.
        slot_uri: pc:media_caption
        range: MediaText
        inlined: true
        required: true
        description: >-

    is_a: Citation
    description: >-
      A citation as the shared record keeps it: an older one as it was written, or one the
      site writer locates on the printed page, with the addresses of the words it quotes.
    attributes:
      addresses:
        range: PrintedAddress
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        minimum_cardinality: 1
        description: >-
          Where on the page pictures the quoted words are printed.
    # The generated JSON Schema does not carry a parent's any_of to a child class (measured,
    # linkml/README.md), so Citation's is written again here.
    any_of:
      - description: >-
          A citation names where in its source the evidence is.
        slot_conditions:
          record_id:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          page:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          scan:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          time:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          unit_id:
            required: true
            pattern: '\S'
      - slot_conditions:
          url:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          locator:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          reference_code:
            required: true

SourcedDate:
    # ADR 0001: dates are governed by RiC-O's Date, its printed words kept as expressedDate.
    class_uri: rico:Date
    description: >-
      A date a source gives: a normalized start (and end, for a range) with how precise it is,
      or the words as printed with their calendar, or both.
    attributes:
      start:
        range: IsoYearMonthOrDay
        description: >-
          The date's start, as far as it is known: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
      end:
        range: IsoYearMonthOrDay
        description: >-
          The end of a range of dates, written as the start is.
      precision:
        range: SourcedDatePrecision
        description: >-
          How much of the date is known: year, month, day or range.
      printed:
        # ADR 0001: the printed words of a date are rico:expressedDate.
        slot_uri: rico:expressedDate
        range: NonBlankText
        description: >-
          The date's words as the source prints or writes them.
      printed_calendar:
        range: PrintedCalendar
        description: >-
          The calendar of the printed words.
      inferred:
        range: boolean
        description: >-
          True when the date was worked out rather than read.
    rules:
      - description: >-
          A sourced date without a start has printed words.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            start:
              value_presence: ABSENT
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            printed:
              required: true
      - description: >-
          A sourced date with a calendar has printed words.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            printed_calendar:
              value_presence: PRESENT
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            printed:
              required: true
      - description: >-
          A sourced date with an end is a range.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            end:
              value_presence: PRESENT
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            precision:
              equals_string: range
      - description: >-
          A range has a start and an end.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            precision:
              equals_string: range
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            start:
              required: true
            end:
              required: true
      - description: >-
          A date known to the year has a start of a year.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            precision:
              equals_string: year
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            start:
              required: true
              pattern: '^\d{4}$'
      - description: >-
          A date known to the month has a start of a month.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            precision:
              equals_string: month
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            start:
              required: true
              pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}$'
      - description: >-
          A date known to the day has a start of a day.
        preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            precision:
              equals_string: day
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            start:
              required: true
              pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'
